Webbed_Frogfish_Legs.description: Equipped with the sinuous, webbed legs of a piscine predator, the Webbed_Frogfish_Legs augment one's strength and agility, enabling powerful leaps and swift traversal through both water and land, while granting the mastery of the Swim_Dash and Aerobatics skills.

Heavy_Coelacanth_Lobe_Legs.description: Enormous, piscine legs that resemble the ancient coelacanth, these heavy appendages are armored with bony plates and grant their bearer immense strength and resilience, allowing them to both stride with the power of a mountain and cut through water with grace, while also providing formidable defensive and offensive capabilities.

Slippery_Eel_Coiling_Legs.description: Emerging from the shadows of the murky depths, the Slippery Eel Coiling Legs are a serpentine appendage, granting unparalleled agility and the ability to traverse treacherous terrains with ease, their slick, sinuous form allowing them to ignore environmental penalties and ensnare foes with a deadly grip.

Camouflaging_Flounder_Flat_Legs.description: The Camouflaging Flounder Flat Legs are a bizarre yet marvelously adapted set of piscine limbs, allowing their owner to glide seamlessly through both water and land with an eerie stealth that renders them nearly invisible, enhanced by their innate ability to alter their appearance to match their surroundings.

Armored_Sturgeon_Spiked_Legs.description: The armored sturgeon spiked legs are a formidable set of piscine appendages, their thick, scaled joints providing an additional layer of natural armor and granting the bearer immense strength, making them capable of both powerful blocks and the destructive sundering of enemy weapons.

Bioluminescent_Viperfish_Clawed_Legs.description: These clawed legs, borrowed from the enigmatic bioluminescent viperfish, grant an eerie glow and a keen perception, enhancing both wisdom and dexterity, and bestowing the user with the ability to cast light and induce bleeding with precise, slashing attacks.

Ghost_Koi_Spectral_Legs.description: The Ghost Koi's spectral legs, barely visible to the naked eye, allow it to swim through water and hover over land, blending seamlessly with its surroundings while granting it enhanced stealth and evasion abilities, making it a formidable unseen predator in the realm's murky depths and shadowed plains.

Electric_Ray_Shocking_Legs.description: Equipped with piscine legs that shimmer with electric vitality, this magical appendage grants unmatched agility and wisdom, allowing the wielder to dash through water with the speed of a lightning strike and reflect incoming spells with a flick of their electrically charged feet.

Venomous_Lionfish_Spiked_Legs.description: Equipped with the venomous lionfish's spiked legs, a being gains the fluid grace of a piscine predator on land and water, while the toxic spines offer a defensive aura that deters foes and enhances resilience, granting a defensive edge and the lethal ability to unleash a cloud of poisonous mist.

Streamlined_Shark_Pelvic_Legs.description: These sleek, finned appendages pulsate with an otherworldly grace, allowing their wielder to move with unparalleled agility both on land and in water, granting them the fluidity of a shark and the ability to dash through currents or leap through the air with uncanny ease.
